المعايرة

rows:
تجميع المعلومات عن حالة أجهزة قياس درجات الحرارة السابقة من 
 المسؤلين بالمحطة

معاينة العدادات المطلوب معايرتها واثبات الحالة الموجودة 
 عليها

رفع غطاء جهاز قياس درجة الحرارة وتدوين ونقل الرقم المسلسل 
 وقيم المراحل المضبوط عليها

التأكد من سلامة التوصيلات الثانوية لمحولات التيار المركبة 
 على جسم المحول وتحديد نسب التحويل

استخدام المفتاح المناسب لفك صامولة الحساس (Sensor) من الجراب 
 أعلى جسم المحول

اختبار جراب مناسب للحساس (Sensor) للعمل به داخل جهاز 
 المعايرة

تنظيف الحساس (Sensor) جيدا قبل وضعه بالجراب داخل جهاز 
 المعايرة
ضبط جهاز المعايرة على درجة حرارة معينة

الأنتظار فترة زمنية مناسبة 10-15 دقيقة حتى تستقر قراءة جهاز 
 قياس درجة الحرارة ثم تسجل القراءة

رفع درجة الحرارة على خطوات مع تسجيل القيم الخاصة بحرارة جهاز 
 المعايرة وحرارة جهاز قياس درجة حرارة المحول فى الجدول الآتى 
 مع ملاحظة القيم التى ستعمل عندها المراحل المضبوط عليها جهاز 
 قياس درجة الحرارة

فى حالة 
 زيادة نسبة الخطأ عن 5 % 
 أثناء المعايرة يتم محاولة اصلاح جهاز 
 قياس درجة الحرارة للمحول وذلك عن طريق مراجعة التوصيلات وضبط 
 قيم المقاومات المتغيرة الخاصة بجهاز قياس درجة حرارة المحول 
 للوصول الى نسبة خطأ اقل من او يساوى 5%

عند معايرة جهاز قياس درجة حرارة الملفات تتم نفس الخطوات 
 الخاصة بمعايرة جهاز قياس درجة حرارة الزيت مع حقن تيار ثانوى يمثل 50% من التيار المقنن للمحول ثم حقن تيار 
 ثانوى يمثل 100% من التيار المقنن للمحول مع تثبيت درجة حرارة جهاز المعايرة ويتم تسجيل النتائج فى الجدول 
 الاتى:-

sections_en.text: Note

The maximum difference in the temperatures recorded on the device in the two cases (without current injection – with current injection) is about 10–14 °C at maximum load. If the difference exceeds 14 °C, an attempt shall be made to repair the winding temperature measuring device by checking the connections and adjusting the variable resistor values of the winding temperature measuring device to reach the proper difference in readings.
Steps for returning the measuring device to its place after calibration:
After calibration is finished, the sensor shall be placed back inside its pocket on top of the transformer tank.
Ensure that the sensor pocket is filled with oil.
Re-tighten the sensor nut on top of the transformer tank and ensure it is securely tightened.
Refit the cover of the temperature measuring device.
Hand over the site to the station officials.
Close the work order, keeping the original.
The work shall be recorded in the protection logbook.

Introduction
This document sets out the calibration steps for transformer temperature measuring devices (oil and winding).
Safety Precautions
Issue a work order, with the occupational safety and health category card available for the personnel named in the work order | 
Ensure the cells adjacent to the work location are fenced off and warning and caution signs are posted | 
Take over the work site | 
Ensure switching-off operations (for the transformer) are completed by reviewing the switching programme | 
Ensure the AC and DC supplies are disconnected | 
Ensure absence of voltage using the tested voltage indicator |

Calibration Steps
Collect information on the previous condition of the temperature measuring devices from the station officials | 1.
Inspect the gauges to be calibrated and record their existing condition | 2.
Remove the cover of the temperature measuring device and record the serial number and the stage setting values | 3.
Check the soundness of the secondary connections of the current transformers mounted on the transformer tank and determine the transformation ratios | 4.
Use the appropriate spanner to unscrew the sensor nut from the pocket on top of the transformer tank | 5.
Select a suitable pocket for the sensor to be used inside the calibration device | 6.
Clean the sensor thoroughly before placing it in the pocket inside the calibration device | 7.
Set the calibration device to a specific temperature | 8.
Wait a suitable period of 10–15 minutes until the reading of the temperature measuring device stabilises, then record the reading | 9.
Raise the temperature in steps, recording the values of the calibration device temperature and the transformer temperature measuring device temperature in the following table, noting the values at which the stages set on the temperature measuring device will operate | 10.
Error % = (Calibration device − Transformer device) / Calibration device
If the error exceeds 5% during calibration, an attempt shall be made to repair the transformer temperature measuring device by checking the connections and adjusting the variable resistor values of the transformer temperature measuring device to reach an error of less than or equal to 5% | 6.
When calibrating the winding temperature measuring device, the same steps as for calibrating the oil temperature measuring device shall be followed, with secondary current injection representing 50% of the transformer rated current, then secondary current injection representing 100% of the transformer rated current, while holding the calibration device temperature constant; the results shall be recorded in the following table:- | 7.

Note
The maximum difference in the temperatures recorded on the device in the two cases (without current injection – with current injection) is about 10–14 °C at maximum load. If the difference exceeds 14 °C, an attempt shall be made to repair the winding temperature measuring device by checking the connections and adjusting the variable resistor values of the winding temperature measuring device to reach the proper difference in readings.

Refit the cover of the temperature measuring device.
